responsibility: Summarizes the purpose of the vendored polonius-engine crate that models Rust borrow checking for gccrs’s Polonius integration. It identifies the library as the core alias-based borrow-check analysis shared between rustc-oriented tooling and test/profiling front ends, giving high-level conceptual context for the engine that consumes collected facts, without implementing the GCC-side interface or diagnostics.
same_name_distinction: This README.md is the vendored documentation for polonius-engine itself, distinguishing it from the other README.md files by describing the core borrow-check analysis library that consumes facts, rather than a support crate such as datafrog, log, or rustc-hash.
